title: Samson's Marriage

questions.question: Where did Samson go to find a wife?
questions.explanation: Judges 14:1 (ESV): "Samson went down to Timnah, and at Timnah he saw one of the daughters of the Philistines."

questions.question: What did his parents think of his choice?
options: They disapproved, wanting him to marry a woman from his own people
They wanted him to marry an Egyptian
questions.correctAnswer: They disapproved, wanting him to marry a woman from his own people
questions.explanation: Judges 14:3 (ESV): "But his father and mother said to him, 'Is there not a woman among the daughters of your relatives... that you must go to take a wife from the uncircumcised Philistines?'"

questions.question: What animal did Samson kill with his bare hands?
questions.explanation: Judges 14:5-6 (ESV): "...a young lion came toward him roaring... and he tore the lion in pieces as one tears a young goat."

questions.question: What did he find in the carcass later?
options: A swarm of bees and honey
questions.correctAnswer: A swarm of bees and honey
questions.explanation: Judges 14:8 (ESV): "...behold, there was a swarm of bees in the body of the lion, and honey."

questions.question: What was the wager for the riddle?
options: Thirty linen garments and thirty changes of clothes
questions.correctAnswer: Thirty linen garments and thirty changes of clothes
questions.explanation: Judges 14:12 (ESV): "...then you shall give me thirty linen garments and thirty changes of clothes."

questions.question: What was the riddle?
options: Out of the eater came something to eat. Out of the strong came something sweet.
What has legs but cannot walk?
White as snow, but not cold.
questions.correctAnswer: Out of the eater came something to eat. Out of the strong came something sweet.
questions.explanation: Judges 14:14 (ESV): "And he said to them, 'Out of the eater came something to eat. Out of the strong came something sweet.'"

questions.question: How did the Philistine companions solve the riddle?
options: They threatened Samson's wife to get the answer
questions.correctAnswer: They threatened Samson's wife to get the answer
questions.explanation: Judges 14:15 (ESV): "...they said to Samson's wife, 'Entice your husband to tell us what the riddle is, lest we burn you and your father's house with fire.'"

questions.question: What did Samson say when they answered correctly?
options: If you had not plowed with my heifer, you would not have found out my riddle
questions.correctAnswer: If you had not plowed with my heifer, you would not have found out my riddle
questions.explanation: Judges 14:18 (ESV): "...If you had not plowed with my heifer, you would not have found out my riddle."

questions.question: Where did Samson get the clothes to pay the wager?
questions.explanation: Judges 14:19 (ESV): "And the Spirit of the LORD rushed upon him, and he went down to Ashkelon and struck down thirty men... and took their spoil and gave the garments..."

questions.question: What happened to Samson's wife after he left?
options: She was given to his companion (best man)
questions.correctAnswer: She was given to his companion (best man)
questions.explanation: Judges 14:20 (ESV): "And Samson's wife was given to his companion, who had been his best man."

questions.question: Why was this marriage "from the Lord"?
options: For he was seeking an opportunity against the Philistines
questions.correctAnswer: For he was seeking an opportunity against the Philistines
questions.explanation: Judges 14:4 (ESV): "His father and mother did not know that it was from the LORD, for he was seeking an opportunity against the Philistines."

questions.question: How long did the feast last?
questions.explanation: Judges 14:17 (ESV): "She wept before him the seven days that their feast lasted..."

questions.question: Did Samson tell his parents about the honey?
options: No, he did not tell them
questions.correctAnswer: No, he did not tell them
questions.explanation: Judges 14:9 (ESV): "...but he did not tell them that he had scraped the honey from the carcass of the lion."

questions.question: What day did they answer the riddle?
questions.explanation: Judges 14:18 (ESV): "And the men of the city said to him on the seventh day before the sun went down..."

questions.question: Where were the vineyards located where the lion attacked?
questions.explanation: Judges 14:5 (ESV): "Then Samson went down... to Timnah, and they came to the vineyards of Timnah..."

key_verse_text: Then the Spirit of the LORD rushed upon him, and he tore the lion in pieces as one tears a young goat. (ESV)
